results.description: Mr Udhayakumar allegedly made the remarks while addressing AIADMK cadres at a Jayalalithaa Peravai meeting in Thoothukudi on August 8, while criticising the Tamil Nadu government’s failure to get Karnataka to release the Cauvery water ordered by the Cauvery Water Management Authority (CWMA).

results.title: Jharkhand Exam Row Intensifies: BJP Calls Statewide Bandh As ED Launches Money Laundering Probe
results.description: Protests by JPSC aspirants in Jharkhand heightened as thousands marched towards the state Assembly, leading to police using water cannons and lathi-charge to disperse them. The Enforcement Directorate began a money laundering investigation into recruitment exam irregularities, and former JPSC chairperson L Khiangte was arrested.
